name: Ganesha
summary: The remover of obstacles, invoked at every beginning.
symbolicNote: Welcomed first into the mandir — he clears the path before any sacred work.

name: Shiva
summary: The auspicious one, lord of stillness and transformation.
symbolicNote: Presides over endings that make space for renewal.

name: Vishnu
summary: The preserver who sustains the order of the world.
symbolicNote: Held close in vows of protection and continuity.

name: Lakshmi
summary: Goddess of prosperity, grace, and abundance.
symbolicNote: Invited in gratitude and for the wellbeing of the home.

name: Durga
summary: The invincible mother, fierce and protective.
symbolicNote: Turned to for courage and shelter in hard seasons.

name: Hanuman
summary: The devoted one, embodiment of strength and service.
symbolicNote: A companion for vows that ask for steadfastness.

name: Krishna
summary: The divine lover, teacher of the Gita.
symbolicNote: Held in joy, longing, and the practice of letting go.

name: Saraswati
summary: Goddess of wisdom, learning, and the arts.
symbolicNote: Sought at the start of study and creative work.

name: Rama
summary: The ideal one, who keeps his word through every trial.
symbolicNote: A presence for personal vows and quiet integrity.

name: Parvati
summary: The mountain goddess, devotion made patient and enduring.
symbolicNote: Honoured in reconnection and the slow keeping of love.

name: Murugan
summary: The divine youth, vanquisher of inner darkness.
symbolicNote: Beloved across the South; called on for clarity and resolve.

name: Kali
summary: The fierce protector who cuts through illusion.
symbolicNote: Met in grief and in the fearless facing of truth.
